items.t: Trump, Xi and Putin issue 'peace declaration' in Shenzhen
items.d: The first three-way summit ended with a pledge to hold talks on cutting nuclear risks and stopping proliferation. Ukraine and the Iran war got little detail, but Trump said Xi agreed the Strait of Hormuz must stay open.

items.t: Anthropic shares soar in record-breaking Nasdaq debut
items.d: Priced at $83 after raising $81.3bn, the biggest IPO ever, Anthropic opened at about $111.50 and hit $114.99. The debut is seen as a test of how much investors will pay for AI.

items.t: Iran hits US base in Kuwait and Bahrain as Gulf war widens
items.d: Iran launched drones at a US airbase in Kuwait and attacked Bahrain after a US strike on Qeshm Island. A tanker was hit off Oman and Trump said the conflict would end 'one way or the other'.

items.t: UN top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
items.d: The International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide over the 2017 military campaign against the Rohingya, a landmark ruling in a case brought by The Gambia.

items.t: Putin vows 'far more painful' response to Crimean Bridge strikes
items.d: Speaking during his China trip, Putin threatened tougher retaliation after Ukrainian attacks on the bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, even as he praised talks with Trump and Xi.

items.t: Venezuela signs military deal with the US
items.d: Less than a year after Nicolás Maduro was removed, Caracas agreed a defence pact with Washington, deepening US influence over the oil-rich country.

items.t: Denmark approves Greenland defence deal with the US
items.d: Danish MPs backed a security agreement letting the US set up new defence areas in Greenland, easing a long row over the Arctic island.

items.t: FTSE 100 slips while Wall Street eyes Anthropic
items.d: London's blue chips ended lower on Thursday as attention turned to Anthropic's debut in New York, which lifted US tech sentiment after a shaky week for AI stocks.

items.t: US group beats Chinese rivals to huge Kenya mining deal
items.d: A US-led consortium won a major Kenyan mining contract, a sign of Washington's push to secure critical minerals in Africa against Chinese competition.

items.t: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m
items.d: The work fetched a record price at auction in New York despite a dispute over its history under the Nazis, showing strong demand at the top of the art market.

items.t: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon model
items.d: The new mid-tier model ranks third on the Artificial Analysis index behind GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, costs $3/$15 per million tokens, and replaces Argon in the Gemini app.

items.t: Intel lands first outside customer for its 18A chips
items.d: Intel says it has signed its first external client for its most advanced process, with yields reportedly at 70%, and Microsoft is using its EMIB packaging. It is a boost for Intel's foundry comeback.

items.t: GTA 6 launches worldwide to record reviews
items.d: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI is now out, after becoming the best-reviewed game ever on Metacritic. Fans queued and took time off; PS5 owners need a firmware update to play.

items.t: New US chip curbs on South East Asia aim at China
items.d: Washington's latest restrictions target AI chips flowing through South East Asian data centres, closing a route Chinese firms have used to reach advanced computing power.

items.t: Anthropic IPO puts AI's circular financing to the test
items.d: Big backers such as Google, Microsoft and Nvidia also sell Anthropic chips and cloud. The listing tests whether that web of deals reflects real demand.

items.t: DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 impresses geneticists
items.d: The new AI can predict which cell types a DNA variant is likely to affect, which could speed up the search for the genetic causes of disease.

items.t: RSV jabs are slashing infections, data show
items.d: Vaccines and antibody injections against RSV are sharply cutting hospital admissions in babies and older people, a big win against a common winter virus.

items.t: New obesity definition beats BMI at predicting health
items.d: Adding waist size to height and weight gives a more accurate picture of health risk than BMI alone, researchers report.

items.t: Covid inquiry delivers verdict on test and trace
items.d: The UK Covid inquiry's latest report sets out its findings on testing, contact tracing and the 2021 'pingdemic', when app alerts forced huge numbers to isolate.

items.t: Timetable set for ending leasehold in England and Wales
items.d: The government set out when the leasehold system will be dismantled, moving homeowners towards commonhold and ending ground rents and many service-charge disputes.

items.t: 特朗普、習近平、普京深圳發表「和平宣言」
items.d: 首次三方峰會結束，三國承諾就降低核風險及防止核擴散展開對話。宣言對烏克蘭及伊朗戰事着墨不多，但特朗普稱習近平同意霍爾木茲海峽必須保持暢通。

items.t: Anthropic納斯達克上市首日股價急升
items.d: Anthropic以每股83美元招股，集資813億美元，為史上最大規模IPO。股價首日以約111.50美元開市，最高見114.99美元，被視為市場對AI估值的試金石。

items.t: 伊朗襲擊科威特美軍基地及巴林　海灣戰火擴大
items.d: 美軍空襲格什姆島後，伊朗向科威特美軍空軍基地發射無人機，並襲擊巴林。一艘油輪在阿曼對開被擊中，特朗普稱衝突將「以這種或那種方式」結束。

items.t: 國際法院裁定緬甸對羅興亞人犯種族滅絕罪
items.d: 國際法院裁定，緬甸須為2017年針對羅興亞人的軍事行動負上種族滅絕責任。案件由岡比亞提出，裁決具里程碑意義。

items.t: 普京揚言就克里米亞大橋遇襲作「更痛」回應
items.d: 普京訪華期間表示，烏克蘭襲擊連接俄羅斯與被佔克里米亞的大橋後，俄方會作出更嚴厲報復，同時讚揚與特朗普及習近平的會談。

items.t: 委內瑞拉與美國簽訂軍事協議
items.d: 馬杜羅下台不足一年，委內瑞拉與美國簽署防務協議，美國對這個石油大國的影響力進一步加深。

items.t: 丹麥國會通過格陵蘭防務協議
items.d: 丹麥國會通過安全協議，容許美國在格陵蘭設立新防務區域，緩和雙方就這個北極島嶼的長期爭拗。

items.t: 富時100指數回落　市場焦點落在Anthropic
items.d: 倫敦藍籌股周四收低，市場注意力集中在Anthropic紐約上市，提振經歷波動一周的美國科技股氣氛。

items.t: 美國財團擊敗中國對手奪肯尼亞大型礦業合約
items.d: 一個美國牽頭的財團奪得肯尼亞大型採礦合約，反映華府正積極在非洲爭取關鍵礦產，與中國競爭。

items.t: 梵高畫作以創紀錄1.904億美元成交
items.d: 畫作雖涉納粹時期來歷爭議，仍在紐約拍賣以破紀錄價格成交，顯示頂級藝術品市場需求強勁。

items.t: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon模型
items.d: 新中階模型在Artificial Analysis指數排第三，僅次於GPT-6.2 Astra及Claude Fable 5.2，收費每百萬token 3/15美元，並在Gemini app取代Argon。

items.t: Intel 18A製程首獲外部客戶
items.d: Intel表示其最先進製程簽下首個外部客戶，良率據報達七成，Microsoft亦採用其EMIB封裝技術，為Intel晶圓代工業務重振帶來支持。

items.t: 《GTA 6》全球推出　評分破紀錄
items.d: Rockstar的《俠盜獵車手6》正式推出，此前已成為Metacritic史上評分最高遊戲。玩家排隊搶購甚至請假，PS5用家須先更新系統才能遊玩。

items.t: 美國對東南亞晶片新限制劍指中國
items.d: 華府最新措施針對經東南亞數據中心流動的AI晶片，堵塞中國企業取得先進算力的途徑。

items.t: Anthropic上市考驗AI「循環融資」
items.d: Google、Microsoft及Nvidia等大股東同時向Anthropic出售晶片及雲端服務，上市將檢驗這些交易是否反映真實需求。

items.t: DeepMind AlphaGenome 2令科學家驚嘆
items.d: 新AI能預測DNA變異可能影響哪類細胞，有助加快尋找疾病的遺傳成因。

items.t: 數據顯示RSV疫苗大減感染
items.d: 預防呼吸道合胞病毒的疫苗及抗體針，大幅減少嬰兒及長者入院個案，對付這種常見冬季病毒成效顯著。

items.t: 新肥胖定義預測健康比BMI更準
items.d: 研究指出，在身高體重以外加入腰圍，比單用BMI更準確反映健康風險。

items.t: 新冠調查報告評檢測及追蹤系統
items.d: 英國新冠疫情公開調查最新報告，就檢測、接觸追蹤及2021年「通知疫潮」作出結論，當時程式通知令大批人須隔離。

items.t: 政府公布英格蘭及威爾斯廢除租賃業權時間表
items.d: 政府公布逐步拆解租賃業權制度的時間表，業主將轉向共同業權，地租及不少管理費爭拗可望終結。
